title: Google Workspace Overview
description: A Google Workspace account's audit activities: logins and failed or suspicious logins, 2-step verification, Admin console changes, Drive files shared outside the domain, OAuth apps authorized, group and device changes, and the Cloud SIEM signals they raise.

definition.content:
**Google Workspace audit activities** record who signed in and from where, what administrators changed in the Admin console, who shared Drive files outside the domain, which OAuth apps users authorized, and group, account and device changes. This dashboard follows them, the users and addresses behind them, and the Cloud SIEM signals their detection rules raise.

Connect Google Workspace in [Integrations → Google Workspace](/integrations/google-workspace): a service account reads the Admin SDK Reports API every five minutes, with no access to ObserveCraft needed. Google delivers some applications' activities hours late; they appear here as they arrive.
